Product Description
ZEP OVEN & GRILL CLEANER
Oven & Grill Cleaner dissolves grease on contact. Its thick foam clings to surfaces while an advanced grease-cutting formula penetrates deep to cut through the toughest of stains. The cleaner is suitable for use on stainless steel, porcelain and ceramic, making it ideal for cleaning ovens, grills, pots, pans, rotisseries and burner drip pans.
Dissolves grease on contact
